name: cardiac_quadratic_reference_gamg_v1
scope: Separate full-cycle solver-equivalence experiment after five accepted fixed-history nonlinear probes. Native GMRES/GAMG with rigid-body near-nullspace; all mechanics, geometry, P2 space, 1.25ms timestep, initial conditions and physical acceptance criteria match the completed direct reference. No direct trajectory is replaced. Compare all800 recursively generated states and whole-element positivity before considering changes to the production solver. This engineering control does not establish mesh/time convergence or select neural models.
